mods.name: Alex's Caves (Fabric)
mods.description: Unofficial Fabric port of Alex's Caves for Minecraft 26.1.2. Explore new rare cave biomes hidden under the surface of the Overworld. Original mod by Alexthe668 and Noonyeyz; this Fabric port is maintained by Thiov and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the original authors. Requires the Citadel library, installed separately.

releases.notes:
- Fixed unfilled cave maps (and potentially other items) being invisible when held. Copying an item's data onto its inventory sprite was also copying its MODEL, so the sprite pointed back at the original item and ended up drawing nothing. This affected nine places in the renderer, all fixed
- The cave map is now double-sided, which should fix it being invisible in third person. Upstream drew it without face culling and that flag was being silently ignored

The slight transparency is intentional and matches the original mod, so I've left it alone.

Requires Minecraft 26.1.2 + Fabric.

releases.notes:
- Your hands are drawn around the cave map again in first person. The method upstream used for this was renamed and reworked in 26.1, and the port had simply deleted it

The cave map being invisible in third person is still open. Every check on that code path looks correct, so rather than guess I've added a one-shot log line to find out whether it runs at all. If you hold a filled cave map in third person and then check your latest.log for a line containing "cave map third-person branch reached", that single fact tells me which half of the problem to fix.

Requires Minecraft 26.1.2 + Fabric.

mods.name: Alex's Caves (Fabric)
mods.description: Unofficial Fabric port of Alex's Caves for Minecraft 26.1.2. Explore new rare cave biomes hidden under the surface of the Overworld. Original mod by Alexthe668 and Noonyeyz; this Fabric port is maintained by Thiov and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the original authors. Requires the Citadel library, installed separately.

releases.notes:
- Irradiation is a real glow again, not a flat green overlay. Two bugs were stacked: the glow was never actually being routed to its off-screen buffer, and that buffer's depth was never cleared - so when it WAS routed there, every pixel got discarded and you saw nothing at all. Both fixed
- You can swim in acid and purple soda now, and so can mobs. 26.1 handles fluid movement purely as water/lava, and NeoForge removed the bridge that used to let mod fluids hook in, so both fluids were behaving like air. The swim physics now reuse vanilla's own water path
- Acid and soda also register properly as fluids you're inside now, which restores buoyancy, currents and being detected as submerged

Requires Minecraft 26.1.2 + Fabric.

mods.name: Alex's Caves (Fabric)
mods.description: Unofficial Fabric port of Alex's Caves for Minecraft 26.1.2. Explore new rare cave biomes hidden under the surface of the Overworld. Original mod by Alexthe668 and Noonyeyz; this Fabric port is maintained by Thiov and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the original authors. Requires the Citadel library, installed separately.

releases.notes:
- Acid and purple soda now actually affect you and mobs again. The method that handles "an entity is inside this fluid" had the wrong signature for 26.1, so it was never called at all - which is why acid did no damage and neither fluid interacted with anything, while still reacting with water
- Primitive Club fixed. It had three separate problems stacked: its attack damage was never applied (Fabric showed ~1 damage, NeoForge an 80-tick wind-up), an attack-cancelling hook made it deal literally no damage on NeoForge, and a leftover tick handler permanently jammed the swing timer. Its stun effect had also never been running
- Swiftwood now works through the enchantment data instead of dead Java

Still to come: the irradiation glow (it renders now, but as a flat overlay rather than an aura - the real fix is identified), and swimming in acid/soda, which needs new physics code since NeoForge 26.1 removed the fluid-to-entity bridge entirely.

Requires Minecraft 26.1.2 + Fabric.
